requirement: Top management demonstrates accountability for prevention of work-related injury and ill health
evidence_required: Signed HSE policy, MD's documented HSE commitment, HSE on the management-review agenda

requirement: Written OH&S policy communicated in a language workers understand
evidence_required: Bilingual policy displayed on notice boards, induction records

requirement: Defined HSE roles from the Manager Security Health & Safety down to line supervisors
evidence_required: Organogram, job descriptions with HSE accountabilities, appointment letters

requirement: Safety Committee mandatory where 50 or more workers are employed with 50:50 worker-management parity and 6-12 members by headcount
evidence_required: Constitution letter, member list showing worker nomination, quarterly minutes, action register

requirement: Safety Committee meets at least once every three months
evidence_required: Four sets of minutes per year with attendance and closed actions

iso45001_title: Hazard identification and assessment of risks
requirement: Systematic hazard identification and risk assessment covering routine and non-routine activities
evidence_required: HIRA register with initial and residual risk scoring, JSA for high-risk tasks, review dates

requirement: Maintained register of applicable HSE legal requirements with compliance status
evidence_required: Legal register with citation, applicability, owner and evidence

requirement: Measurable HSE objectives with leading and lagging indicators
evidence_required: Annual HSE objectives, KPI dashboard, progress reviews

requirement: Workers competent on the basis of education and training appropriate to their hazards
evidence_required: Training matrix by role, attendance and assessment records, competency certificates for boiler, electrical and forklift operators

requirement: Workers aware of hazards, the OH&S policy, their right to remove themselves from danger and their protection from reprisal
evidence_required: Induction records, toolbox talk records, signed just-culture policy

requirement: Internal and external HSE communication process including SDS in a language workers understand
evidence_required: Bilingual SDS at point of use, notice boards, incident bulletins

requirement: Controlled HSE documented information retained and maintained
evidence_required: Document register with version and review dates, retention schedule

iso45001_title: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks
requirement: Hierarchy of controls applied, with machinery guarded and dangerous parts securely fenced
evidence_required: Guard register, guard audit report, interlock test records

iso45001_title: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks
requirement: Valid inspection certificates for lifting machinery and pressure plant
evidence_required: Third-party certificates for boiler, air receivers, ammonia vessels, hoists and forklifts, with expiry tracking

iso45001_title: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks
requirement: Valid electrical system certification and maintained installation
evidence_required: Electrical installation certificate, thermography report, ELCB test records

iso45001_title: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks
requirement: Permit to Work system controlling hot work, confined space, work at height, electrical and line breaking
evidence_required: Permit register, closed permits with gas-test and fire-watch records, permit audit findings

iso45001_title: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks
requirement: Lockout-Tagout applied to all energy isolation during maintenance and cleaning
evidence_required: LOTO procedure, equipment-specific isolation sheets, padlock register, LOTO audit

iso45001_title: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks
requirement: PPE provided free of charge, matched to the assessed hazard, and used
evidence_required: PPE hazard-matching matrix, issue register, fit-test records for respirators and hearing protection, compliance observation data

requirement: HSE review before new plant, chemicals, processes or layout changes are commissioned
evidence_required: MOC register with pre-start safety review sign-off

requirement: Contractor HSE pre-qualification, induction, method statements and performance monitoring
evidence_required: Contractor pre-qualification scores, induction records, approved method statements, contractor incident data

bd_legal_reference: BLA 2006 s.62; s.89; Fire Prevention and Extinction Act 2003 ss.4 & 8
requirement: Fire licence valid; means of escape adequate and unobstructed; alarm and detection functional
evidence_required: Fire licence, escape-route weekly checklist, alarm and detection test records, extinguisher servicing records

requirement: Documented emergency plan and periodic drills including scenario-specific drills
evidence_required: Emergency plan, drill records with muster times and debriefs, at least one night-shift drill and one ammonia scenario per year

requirement: First-aid boxes to the prescribed scale and certified first-aiders on every shift
evidence_required: First-aid box inventory checks, first-aider certificates and shift roster

requirement: Health checks for workers engaged in dangerous operations
evidence_required: Occupational health examination records, exposure register by similar exposure group, audiometry results

requirement: Workplace hygiene: ventilation, lighting, temperature, drinking water with certificate, sanitation to scale
evidence_required: Hygiene survey, drinking-water test certificate, lux and WBGT survey, toilet-to-worker ratio

requirement: Periodic evaluation of compliance with legal requirements
evidence_required: Compliance evaluation report with non-conformances and corrective actions

requirement: Planned internal HSE audit programme covering the whole management system
evidence_required: Audit programme, audit reports, non-conformance and corrective-action register with closure dates

requirement: Top management reviews the OH&S management system at planned intervals
evidence_required: Management review minutes covering incidents, audit results, KPI performance, legal changes and resources

bd_legal_reference: BLA 2006 s.80 (notice of accident); BLR 2015 r.73 & Schedule IV(2)
requirement: Accidents notified to the authority as required and investigated with root causes and corrective actions
evidence_required: Statutory accident notification copies, investigation reports with root-cause analysis, CAPA register with verification of effectiveness

requirement: Demonstrated continual improvement of HSE performance
evidence_required: Trend analysis of leading and lagging indicators over at least 24 months

iso45001_title: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks
requirement: Structural adequacy of buildings certified and maintained
evidence_required: Structural assessment report by a licensed engineer, occupancy and load-limit signage per floor

bd_legal_reference: Environment Conservation Act 1995; Environment Conservation Rules 1997
requirement: Valid Environmental Clearance Certificate; effluent and emissions within the prescribed standards
evidence_required: ECC with renewal tracking, monthly effluent test reports, bi-annual stack monitoring reports

requirement: Hazardous and general waste segregated, stored and disposed through authorised routes
evidence_required: Waste inventory, disposal manifests from licensed contractors, sludge disposal records

iso45001_title: Hazard identification and assessment of risks
requirement: No worker required to lift or carry a load likely to cause injury
evidence_required: Manual-handling assessment, mechanical-aid inventory, weight limits posted

bd_legal_reference: BLA 2006 s.86; BLR 2015 r.79 & Schedule IV 1, 11 & 12
requirement: Workers protected from reprisal when reporting hazards or removing themselves from imminent danger
evidence_required: Just-culture policy, grievance records, worker interview evidence
